text: Deep learning models such as transformers have revolutionized artificial intelligence by enabling large-scale reasoning and language understanding.
Artificial general intelligence research explores building systems capable of performing any intellectual task a human can.
An AI agent perceives its environment and takes actions to maximize a reward signal defined by its objective function.
Knowledge representation and symbolic reasoning remain foundational pillars of classical artificial intelligence systems.
Expert systems use rule-based inference engines to emulate the decision-making ability of a human specialist.
Supervised machine learning algorithms learn a mapping from labelled input features to target outputs.
Gradient boosting and random forests are popular ensemble methods used for structured tabular data prediction.
Feature engineering and cross-validation are essential steps in building a robust machine learning pipeline.
Overfitting occurs when a model learns noise in the training data rather than generalizable patterns.
Support vector machines find an optimal hyperplane that maximizes the margin between class boundaries.
Convolutional neural networks extract hierarchical spatial features from images for object recognition tasks.
Image segmentation partitions a digital image into multiple regions to simplify object detection and analysis.
Optical character recognition converts scanned document images into machine-readable text.
Facial recognition systems use deep embeddings to compare and identify individuals from photographs.
Object detection models like YOLO predict bounding boxes and class labels in a single forward pass.
Natural language processing enables machines to understand, interpret, and generate human language.
Named entity recognition identifies proper nouns such as people, organizations, and locations within text.
Word embeddings represent words as dense vectors that capture semantic relationships between them.
Sentiment analysis classifies text according to the emotional tone expressed by the author.
Machine translation systems convert text from one natural language into another while preserving meaning.
Autonomous robots use SLAM algorithms to simultaneously map an environment and localize themselves within it.
Robotic arms rely on inverse kinematics to compute the joint angles required to reach a target position.
Swarm robotics studies how large numbers of simple robots can coordinate to accomplish complex tasks.
Sensor fusion combines data from cameras, lidar, and IMUs to improve a robot's perception accuracy.
Humanoid robots are designed to mimic human motion and interact naturally within human environments.
Penetration testing identifies exploitable vulnerabilities in an organization's network infrastructure before attackers do.
Zero-day vulnerabilities are security flaws that are unknown to the vendor and have no available patch.
Multi-factor authentication significantly reduces the risk of unauthorized account access from stolen credentials.
Ransomware encrypts a victim's files and demands payment in exchange for the decryption key.
Security information and event management systems aggregate logs to detect and respond to threats in real time.
Cloud elasticity allows organizations to automatically scale compute resources up or down based on demand.
Infrastructure as code enables teams to provision and manage cloud resources using version-controlled configuration files.
Container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes automate the deployment and scaling of containerized applications.
A multi-cloud strategy distributes workloads across multiple cloud providers to avoid vendor lock-in.
Serverless computing lets developers run code without provisioning or managing the underlying servers.
